line: An AI can do your errands online now.
Type the task. It handles it. You don't click anything.
So someone put it to the test.
Hundreds of everyday tasks, across a hundred and thirty six real websites.
The best AI agent got six in ten right.
A person handed the same list gets almost all of them.
That gap is the part nobody demos.
Perplexity's Comet. Free, on every platform, ready to test.
What it's good at: filling forms, shopping, short multi-step jobs.
What breaks it: long chains, where one wrong step early ruins everything after it.
Not because it's fake. Because it's real, and still young.
The setup's in the link in bio.
Follow for the setup that actually works.
